create_StableUnCLIPImageNormalizer: create a StableUnCLIPImageNormalizer instance with a specified embedding dimension for CLIP image embedding normalization
scale_embeddings: normalize image embeddings by subtracting mean and dividing by standard deviation using the scale method
unscale_embeddings: restore normalized image embeddings by multiplying by std and adding mean using the unscale method
move_to_device: move the StableUnCLIPImageNormalizer mean and std parameters to a specified torch device and dtype
review_StableUnCLIPImageNormalizer: review the StableUnCLIPImageNormalizer class that holds mean and std for normalizing CLIP image embeddings in stable unCLIP
